column1: * Yordano Ventura's contract obligated the Royals to pay him $23M, including $20.25M at the time of his death: $3.25M in 2017, $6.25M in 2018, $9.75M in 2019 and $1M in 2020. It also included language that could void payment for failure to perform because of injury or death from driving while intoxicated. If his death is determined to be an accident (toxicology results will not be public), the Royals could be reimbursed for an undisclosed portion of their payments to his estate under terms of club's insurance policy on the contract.
* Unofficial payroll for purposes of the Competitive Balance Tax under Article XXIII of MLB collective bargaining agreement. Estimated figures in italics.
* Figures include the average annual values of contracts for players on the 40-man roster, plus about $14.5M per club for health and pension benefits.
* Tax Thresholds: Tax is assessed on amount above $195M in 2017, $197M in 2018, $206M in 2019, $208M in 2020, and $210M in 2021.
* Tax Rate: 20% for first-time payors, 30% for second-time payors, 50% for payors for three or more times. Surtax for exceeding threshold by $20M, $40M
The Royals payroll has never exceeded the threshold for MLB's competitive balance tax.
